top_signals.title: Guinness Atkinson CEO Discusses New K-Beauty ETF Launch
top_signals.summary: Jim Atkinson, President & CEO at Guinness Atkinson Funds, discusses the launch of the firm's new K-beauty ETF and his outlook for demand. He speaks on Bloomberg's ETQ IQ Asia. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
